GREETINGS: WHEREAS by Clause ( , of Article 52 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalamf it is provided that unless otherwise directed by His Majesty the Sultan an d Yang Di-Pertuan, there shall be a session Of the Legislative Council once at least in every yearr SO that a period of more than 12 months shall not intervene between the last sitting in one session and the date appointed for its fir st sitting in the next sesslon. AND WHEREAS by Clause ( 2 , of Article 52 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, it is provided that each session of the Legislative Council shall be held at such place and shall commence and end at such time as His Majesty th e Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may from time to time, by notice published in the Gazette, appoint. NOW THEREFORE, notwithstanding th at 12 months will have elapsed between the last sitting in one session of the Legislative Council and the date appointed fo r its first s itting in the next session, We in exercise of the powers conferred upon US by the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam, do hereby direct and appoint the 15th d ay of Rabiulawal, the Hijriah of the Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand, four hundred an d thirty corresponding to the 12th day of March two thousand and nine, to be the date for the commencement of the said fir st sitting in th e n ext session of the Legislative Council to be held at the Bangunan Baru D ewan Majlis, Jalan Kebangsaan, Bandar Seri Begawan, at 8 · 30 olclock in the forenoon. Done at OUR lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam this 8 th day of RabiuIawaI , the Hijriah of Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand, four hundred and thirty corresponding to the 5th day of Marchf two thousand and nine, being the forty-second year of OUR Reign in Brunei Darussalam. 59
